notes.title: Final update
notes.notes:
Thank you so much for your long wait!! I am glad to have finally completed the project I have been dreaming about in the new year!!

🐱About Chapter 3 and the Finale🐶

"WannaWakeUp?" is officially finished! This time, the three main chapters of the game have been updated, and two new endings NE (Normal End) and HE (Happy End) have been added!

🐱Game duration changes🐶

Chapter 1: 30-60 minutes

Chapter 2: 80-120 minutes

Chapter 3 + Finale: 40-70 minutes

 🐱Other updates🐶

· Menu function additions completed (<Memo> and <WeChat>)

· Added W A S D to the operation method

· Installed 7 Steam achievements! Welcome to collect (*｀∀´*)ノ!

Added super beautiful game ending CG X2! And beautiful handwriting! Welcome to unlock!
